# odus

> Tools to provide easy access to prepared data to data scientists that cannot be asked.


## Pages

- [Introduction](index.html.md): - Introduction
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;odus&#96;   | ODUS (Older Drug User Study): data and tools to study drug-use trajectories.   |
- [odus](_autosummary/odus.html.md): ODUS (Older Drug User Study): data and tools to study drug-use trajectories.
- [odus.analysis_utils](_autosummary/odus.analysis_utils.html.md): High-level analyses of drug-use trajectories.
- [odus.dacc](_autosummary/odus.dacc.html.md): Data access: stores and accessors over the survey data.
- [odus.interactive](_autosummary/odus.interactive.html.md): Interactive trajectory plots: hover a cell to see its variable, age, year and value.
- [odus.nothing](_autosummary/odus.nothing.html.md): Universal neutral (identity) elements for accumulation.
- [odus.plot_utils](_autosummary/odus.plot_utils.html.md): Plotting helpers for trajectories and matrices.
- [odus.pobj](_autosummary/odus.pobj.html.md): Dynamic method injection on objects and classes.
- [odus.raw_data_diagnosis](_autosummary/odus.raw_data_diagnosis.html.md): Diagnosis of the raw survey spreadsheets.
- [odus.raw_formats](_autosummary/odus.raw_formats.html.md): Reading raw survey data, of several formats, into trajectories.
- [odus.sequential_var_sets](_autosummary/odus.sequential_var_sets.html.md): Variables and variable sets over sequential (time-indexed) data.
- [odus.util](_autosummary/odus.util.html.md): General utilities: image conversion and multi-image file writing.
